integrity: The exact two-sided bounds and all-order constructions are justified by an elementary analytic proof; no external validation or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Connected finite simple undirected networks; unweighted binary best-shot actions; minimum among pure Nash equilibria, not equilibrium selection or full welfare. Universal proof for all n >= 4, enumeration through n = 6 for corroboration. Unindexed prior results remain possible.
title: Sharp one-link asymmetry in minimum-contributor network equilibria
